text:
April overnight report: The fleet is hot. Mustang, Grande, Legend each posting 100+ yellowtail on their April 92-100 overnights. Class average holding strong at 0.39-0.40 yt/angler. This is consistent with historical April patterns—the overnight class is the reliable play early season. Half-day boats continue to struggle (< 0.02 yt/angler). Watching for water temperature and fleet commitment signals to shape May-June decisions.

The boats vote with their sailings; listen to them.
